description: This Java source file defines the class ListProperties, which serves as a CLI tool to connect to a native property service, retrieve property keys and values via IPC communication, and display them. It contains methods to get all property keys and key-value pairs, demonstrating interaction with a remote service and processing of data structures related to properties.

classes.name: ListProperties
classes.description: A class providing a command-line interface to list property keys and values from a remote service, testing dynamic array communication between C and Java, with main method and helper methods getKeys() and getProperties().

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method that orchestrates retrieving property keys and values by calling getKeys() and getProperties().

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all property keys from the remote service via IPC, prints them, and returns success status.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Retrieves all property key-value pairs from the remote service via IPC, prints details, and returns success status.
